title: Assets / current native references
summary: 69 selected existing assets, ordered by native building/tool/prop family. Native thumbnails show geometry and current default bindings; Environments shows scene overrides. The [reference index](REFERENCE_INDEX.json) also retains metadata and previews for all 98 inspected static/skeletal assets. Long legacy floor/trim bundles with unhelpful tiny thumbnails are catalogued there instead of presented as finished art. [Capture notes](REFERENCE_LIBRARY.md).
